Possible mechanisms of MAPK pathway and its crosstalks with cAMP/PKA, AhR, and PKC signaling in melanogenesis

The possible mechanisms of MAPK pathway and its crosstalks with cAMP/PKA, AhR, and PKC signaling in melanogenesis. MAPK, mitogen-activated protein kinase; MAP3K, MAPK kinase kinases; MAP2K, MAPK kinases; LPS, lipopolysaccharide; USF-1, upstream stimulating factor-1; TYR, tyrosinase; POMC, pro-opiomelanocortin; MCIR, melanin cortin-1 receptor; α-MSH, a–melanocyte-stimulating hormone; c-AMP, cyclic adenosine monophosphate; PKA, c-AMP dependent protein kinase A; CREB, c-AMP response element-binding protein; CRE, c-AMP response element; CRTC3, CREB-regulated transcription coactivator 3; MITF, microphthalmia-associated transcription factor; TRP-1, tyrosinase-related protein 1; TRP-2, tyrosinase-related protein 2; SCF, stem cell factor; c-KIT, proto-oncogene c-Kit; DUSPs, dual-specificity MAPK phosphatases; RSK, ribosomal s6 kinase; AhR, aryl hydrocarbon receptor; hsp90, heat shock protein 90; p23, co-chaperone protein; XAP-2, hepatitis B virus X-associated protein 2; ET-1, Endothelin-1; EDNRB, Endothelin Receptor Type B; PLC, phospholipase C; PKC, protein kinase C.
